newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends at seven-month high.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends at seven-month high.

text.p: Active selling on the American currency pushed the Taiwan dollar sharply higher at the close on Wednesday and dealers said U.S. dollar selling was likely to continue in the near term.

Selling was triggered by strong expectations that the local currency could rise further amid Taiwan dollar liquidity demand before the lunar new year, traditionally a time of high demand, dealers said. The new year falls on February 7 in 1997.
The local unit closed at T$27.382, the highest level since it rose to T$27.342 on May 22, 1996. It closed at T$27.443 on Tuesday. Turnover was a heavy US$468 million.
